x: Young Matthew King made a welcome first appearance for us and in picking up 1st in the 'B' discus and 2nd in the 'B' shot established two new junior records.

Paul Whitby was over the 110 Hurdles in 15.6 and Matthew King won the B shot in 12.02. Jim Evans broke 11 seconds in coming second in the A 100 and Steve Crosbie broke 13m on the triple jump for the first time in three years.
